title: Keto Middle Eastern Shortbread Cookies
description: A crispy and nutty keto dessert inspired by the flavors of the Middle East. These shortbread cookies are made with almond flour and are perfect for a low-carb diet.

ingredients.name: chopped nuts (almonds or any other nuts you like)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream the butter and vanilla extract until light and fluffy.
Gradually add the almond flour, salt, and sugar-free sweetener to the butter mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Scoop the dough into balls, about 1 tablespoon each.
Place the balls onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 2 inches of space between each cookie.
Bake for 18-20 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Remove the cookies from the oven and let them cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
Once the cookies are cool, serve and enjoy!
Note: If you want a crisper cookie, bake for an additional 2-3 minutes.
